Titulo: Apparatus and method for automated vehicle roadside assistance
Depositante_Principal: ESURANCE INC [US] | HARRIS FREDERICK MILES [US] | SRINIVASAN DEEPAK KUMAR [US] | SWIFT PHILIP JAMES [US] | SYKES PAUL DAVID [US] | ESURANCE INSURANCE SERVICES INC
Resumo: A computer readable storage medium includes executable instructions to receive from a mobile device a request regarding a stranded vehicle. The request is processed to determine the location of the stranded vehicle. Additional information regarding the stranded vehicle may be retrieved. The location of the stranded vehicle and the additional information may be communicated as a dispatch request. The location of the stranded vehicle relative to a dispatched vehicle is delivered to the mobile device.
Depositantes_Orig: ESURANCE INC [US] | HARRIS FREDERICK MILES [US] | SRINIVASAN DEEPAK KUMAR [US] | SWIFT PHILIP JAMES [US] | SYKES PAUL DAVID [US] | ESURANCE INSURANCE SERVICES INC

Titulo: Method and Apparatus for Roadside Assistance Facilitation
Depositante_Principal: HATTON DAVID ANTHONY [US] | CHRONOWSKI DAVID [US] | ESSELINK CHAD EVERT [US] | ZIAZADEH NINOS [US] | KIMMERLING GEORGE EDWARD [US] | FORD GLOBAL TECH LLC [US]
Resumo: A roadside assistance system includes a vehicle computing system (VCS), an intermediate system, operable to communicate with the VCS and at least one backend system, and a backend roadside assistance processing system, operable to receive data from the intermediate system and operable to receive calls from the VCS. The VCS is operable to establish communication with the intermediate system. The VCS is further operable to transfer data to the intermediate system, to place a call to the backend roadside assistance processing system, and to relay at least a MIN to the backend roadside assistance processing system. The intermediate system is operable to process transferred data and relay data to the backend roadside system. The backend roadside system is operable to compare the MIN relayed from the VCS with data received from the intermediate system to formulate a dispatch order and to dispatch roadside assistance in accordance with the dispatch order.
Depositantes_Orig: HATTON DAVID ANTHONY [US] | CHRONOWSKI DAVID [US] | ESSELINK CHAD EVERT [US] | ZIAZADEH NINOS [US] | KIMMERLING GEORGE EDWARD [US] | FORD GLOBAL TECH LLC [US]

Titulo: APP roadside assistance system
Depositante_Principal: UNIV TAIPEI CHENGSHIH SCIENCE [TW] | SU TSU-TSE [TW] | HUNG YU SHIN [TW]
Resumo: This patent focuses on the APP development of smart phone. It proposes how to erect the model of roadside assistance and provides the system for any type cars which are breakdown on the way. By the system, it can immediately call services to the center of roadside assistance and then to dispatch the available and the nearest motor vehicle to bound for the GPS located place where is needed for help. The model of roadside assistance adopted in the patent is obtained by the system analysis to maintain a time-stamped and unified database for managing the information such as the status, the dispatching, the GPS location, the Google Map and the car maintenance information of roadside assistance. At the same time, this information can be combined into a smart phone with APP function modules and interfaces which can be applied between the breakdown car, the dispatched car, and the call center of roadside assistance. Therefore, the call center of roadside assistance can dominate the GPS located place where is needed for help and dispatch the available and the nearest motor vehicle to bound for. In addition, this system can support the car maintenance information for recovery convenience.
Depositantes_Orig: UNIV TAIPEI CHENGSHIH SCIENCE [TW] | SU TSU-TSE [TW] | HUNG YU SHIN [TW]

Titulo: Report the accident to the car insurance company that is discharged or roadside assistance, how to request towing
Resumo: The present invention relates to a method capable of delivering car accident report or emergency dispatch request rapidly. The objective of the present invention is to enable a driver facing current situation of an accident to make connection simply and rapidly even though the driver does not know an applied car insurance company or a contact. According to a method for reporting a car accident or emergency dispatch such as battery discharge, flat and towing etc to the car insurance company, a server of an application operation company receiving the situation through an application is connected to a server of the car insurance company. The delivered content is transmitted to the car insurance company by searching the car insurance company with a received car plate number and thus a follow-up action is done. According to the present invention, time delayed in an accident and incident spot is reduced and the follow-up action is rapidly processed.

Titulo: Roadside assistance method
Depositante_Principal: SINO ASSISTANCE CAR RESCUE INDUSTRY CO LTD | LIU YI
Resumo: The invention relates to a roadside assistance method which is characterized by comprising the steps: step 1, a breakdown vehicle feeds back its position information to a server; step 2, the server records the position information; step 3, the vehicle owner sends an assistance request to the server or staff at the service centre; step 4, the server or the staff at the service centre confirms owner's GPS information according to the assistance request; step 5, the server or the staff at the service centre finds out a recovery vehicle nearest to the GPS information from the corresponding breakdown vehicle of the position information; and step 6, the server or the staff at the service centre sends the assistance request to notify the recovery vehicle. As the assistance request is sent, the owner feeds back the GPS information to the server or the staff at the service centre, the recovery vehicle nearest to the owner's GPS position is found out according to the GPS information and is notified to go to the vehicle owner to offer assistance; therefore, the roadside assistance method has the features of simpliness, rapidness and high-efficiency.
Depositantes_Orig: SINO ASSISTANCE CAR RESCUE INDUSTRY CO LTD | LIU YI

Titulo: Geotagging location data
Resumo: Systems and apparatuses for capturing an image of a vehicle for which roadside assistance is being requested are provided. The image may be captured by a mobile device and the mobile device may geotag location information to the image. The image and associated geotag location information may then be processed to determine a location of the vehicle and a roadside assistance issue for which service is being requested. The image may be further analyzed to determine a context including, a make, model and/or year of the vehicle, whether special equipment is needed to service the vehicle, whether the vehicle is located in a particular situation (e.g., within a structure, in a ditch, or the like). The information obtained from the image may be used to determine a type of service to provide to the vehicle and to identify one or more service providers to dispatch to the vehicle.

Titulo: Intelligent service method and system used for automobile maintenance and repair
Depositante_Principal: SHENZHEN MOKA NETWORK TECH CO LTD
Resumo: The present invention relates to a kind of for Motor Maintenance and the intelligent Service method and system of repair, by when the automobile of user is needed to be maintained or is repaired, directly by asking online, maintenance store can establish maintenance/maintenance program, matching driver picks up after user confirms maintenance/maintenance program, vehicle is sent to maintenance store by driver, user is stayed indoors, the maintenance or repair of automobile can be realized, it does not need to wait for Motor Maintenance or repair in garage and waste a large amount of time, has provided the service of more convenient and timesaving to the user.
Depositantes_Orig: SHENZHEN MOKA NETWORK TECH CO LTD

Titulo: Cross-regional vehicle repair resource collaborative management and sharing system based on cloud computing
Depositante_Principal: BEIJING ZHONGCHEXING HI TECH CO LTD
Resumo: The invention discloses a cross-regional repair resource collaborative management and sharing system based on cloud computing, which relates to the technical field of repair data processing, and comprises the following components: performing task skill level analysis and task complexity level analysis to obtain a local task skill level and a local task complexity level; calculating to obtain task skill level and task complexity level; calling technical characteristic information; carrying out mechanic selection optimization to obtain an optimized mechanic group; and selecting an optimal technician by a technician, and dispatching the optimal technician to a local area for processing the steam repair task. The technical problems that the distribution of the steam repair resources among areas is uneven, the steam repair information is difficult to share, the matching degree of the skill and the maintenance task is low in the existing steam repair resource management are solved, and further the maintenance efficiency and quality are low, and the resource utilization efficiency is insufficient are solved, the real-time sharing and the optimal allocation of the cross-area steam repair resources are realized, and the technical effects of improving the steam repair resource utilization efficiency and the maintenance efficiency and the quality are achieved.
Depositantes_Orig: BEIJING ZHONGCHEXING HI TECH CO LTD

Titulo: Online car-hailing service provider price determination method and system
Resumo: The invention relates to the technical field of network about car service, and discloses a method and a system for determining the price of a network about car service provider, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring target vehicle scale data of a target network vehicle-restraining service provider and non-target vehicle scale data of a non-target network vehicle-restraining service provider; calculating autonomous pricing data of the target network vehicle-booking service provider which does not depend on the aggregation platform based on the target vehicle scale data and the non-target vehicle scale data, and determining autonomous profit data of the target network vehicle-booking service provider; calculating platform pricing data of a target network vehicle booking service provider depending on an aggregation platform based on the target vehicle scale data and the non-target vehicle scale data, and determining platform profit data of the target network vehicle booking service provider according to the platform pricing data; comparing the autonomous profit data with the platform profit data, and determining pricing of the target network car booking service provider according to the comparison result; the invention helps the network about car service provider to provide decisions on the pricing, and ensures that the maximum benefit is maintained while the aggregation platform enters the market.

Titulo: Automobile fault maintenance system and method
Depositante_Principal: NANTONG ZHONGQIANG AUTOMOBILE SERVICE CO LTD
Resumo: The invention relates to the technical field of automobile maintenance systems, and discloses an automobile fault maintenance system which comprises a fault analysis module, a maintenance operation module and a data statistics module. According to the automobile fault maintenance system and method, the fault analysis module is used for collecting the vehicle data set and calculating the vehicle maintenance parameters And a vehicle failure index The system analysis is comprehensive, the damage degree of the vehicle is visual, the frequency of the subsequent maintenance period is judged to be more specialized, and the maintenance operation module system calculates the maintenance operation time of the automobile Time and labor are saved, a user can accurately manage maintenance time, travel inconvenience is reduced, and after the data statistics module collects the automobile price data set, an automobile maintenance valuation is calculated And the second hand price ratio of the automobile And the maintenance cost performance is judged by the user through numerical comparison, and the service experience is better.
Depositantes_Orig: NANTONG ZHONGQIANG AUTOMOBILE SERVICE CO LTD

Titulo: Vehicle maintenance quotation method and device based on AI large model, and related system
Resumo: The application provides a vehicle maintenance quotation method, a device and a related system based on an AI large model, which are applied to a server, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a fault code, vehicle information and a fault photo set of a target vehicle; determining a fault area in the target vehicle according to the fault code to obtain a first fault area, extracting a fault photo corresponding to the first fault area from the fault photo set to obtain a first fault photo set, performing fault diagnosis on the target vehicle based on a preset AI large model, the first fault photo set and the fault code to obtain a first diagnosis result, determining a maintenance scheme of the target vehicle according to the first diagnosis result and the vehicle information to obtain a target maintenance scheme, and generating a maintenance quotation of the target vehicle according to the target maintenance scheme. Thus, the accuracy of vehicle fault diagnosis and the efficiency of maintenance quotation can be improved.

Titulo: Method and device for remotely assisting vehicle maintenance
Resumo: The invention discloses a method and a device for remotely assisting in vehicle maintenance, wherein the method detects a maintenance help request sent by a maintenance help terminal; analyzing help content of the target vehicle to obtain an analysis result; generating maintenance help parameters of the target vehicle according to the analysis result of the target vehicle, and publishing or pushing the maintenance assistance request of the target vehicle to a matched maintenance assistance end; the service assistance request of the target vehicle includes a service help parameter of the target vehicle, and the service help parameter of the target vehicle includes a vehicle identification of the target vehicle. Therefore, the help seeking content sent by the vehicle maintenance help seeking end is analyzed, so that corresponding maintenance help seeking parameters are generated and published or directly and accurately sent to the matched maintenance assisting end, the vehicle maintenance help seeking end is not limited to acquaintance circles any more, the vehicle maintenance help seeking area is widened, the vehicle maintenance efficiency is improved, and when a maintenance problem is met, the probability of being solved is improved.

Titulo: Auto Market Rep (platform for finding reliable and affordable auto service vendors)
Resumo: The Auto Market Rep/My Car App provides a unique solution to the problem of finding reliable and affordable auto service vendors. With the ability to add vehicles and track maintenance needs, consumers can quickly and easily submit service requests to a wide range of vendors with a variety of specialties, including auto repair, auto body, tires, glass, electric, towing, upholstery, and more. The app's special algorithm matches consumers with the most suitable vendors, saving them time and money. The app also offers the ability for vendors to bid on jobs and for consumers to compare quotes, ensuring they receive the best service at the best price. The Auto Market Rep/My Car App is a game-changer for the auto service industry, providing a convenient and efficient way for consumers to manage their auto service needs.

Titulo: Method and system for calculating accident vehicle repair cost estimates
Depositante_Principal: SAMSUNG FIRE & MARINE INSURANCE CO LTD [KR]
Resumo: The present disclosure relates to a method and system for providing by calculating an appropriate repair cost estimation of a vehicle thereof when an accident occurs in the vehicle, which is a target of automobile property insurance, that may: extract, from a database, one or more pairs of an official billing document and a component billing document matching vehicle information and damage types inputted from a customer terminal; remove again a pair of billing documents using an unauthorized component from each pair of billing documents from which the billing document has been primarily removed after removing a pair of billing documents comprising an abnormal official billing or the price of an abnormal component from each extracted pair of billing documents; and extract, as a representative estimation document, one official billing document and one component billing document from the remaining pair of billing documents from which the first and second billing documents have been removed and provide to the customer terminal.
Depositantes_Orig: SAMSUNG FIRE & MARINE INSURANCE CO LTD [KR]

Titulo: Vehicle repair cost auto estimation and service system
Depositante_Principal: CMR INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY, BENGALURU; SAVITHA N J; JYOTHI N M
Resumo: Road accidents are the most dangerous situations people deal with on a daily basis. Minor accidentsmerely cause physical damage to vehicles alone and require only a financial settlement between thetwo parties involved in the accident. Most often, during such a situation, neither the party whocaused the accident nor the party whose vehicle got damaged will be aware of the amount needed torepair or replace the damaged part or parts of their vehicles. The two parties will get into a heatedargument if one claims an unreasonable amount for the damage caused, further resulting in variousinconveniences to the public, like traffic jams, manhandling, abusing, and hurting. To estimate thecorrect amount needed to repair the damaged parts, both parties must invest their time to consult theconcerned authority. Due to the busy life schedule, both parties will need more time to spare.This invention relates to a feature wherein, during the time of the accident resulting in vehiculardamages, the cost of repair or replacement can be estimated by taking images of the damaged partsof the vehicle from a mobile phone and using the; mobile application that will estimate the cost ofrepair or replacement from the images fed into the hppIi'cation, thus giving an amicable solution toboth parties. Apart from this, the mobile application can be used to connect to the nearest vehiclerepair and service provider and get the service and repair done.This field of invention correSponds to a mobile application that can estimate the cost of repair orreplacement of damaged part or parts of the vehicle during the time of accidents that results invehicular damage. It also connects to the nearest vehicle repair and service provider.
Depositantes_Orig: Savitha N J; Jyothi N M; CMR INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY, BENGALURU

Titulo: Supplemental service recommendation system (crowdsourced roadside assistance)
Resumo: A supplemental service recommendation system that enables roadside assistance via crowdsourcing. Registered members store their data in the cloud-based server, facilitating efficient assistance requests for clients, providers, and participating shops via a software program such as an app. Geographical correlation and algorithmic analysis of the database ensure seamless matching for the most suitable assistance service. Users can track the approaching service provider in real-time. The system incorporates a secure payment method, enabling users to make direct payments within the platform. With enhanced data utilization and convenient payment options, this system optimizes roadside assistance, fostering a reliable and swift user experience.

Titulo: Global emergency roadside assistance system
Resumo: A system for universal repair referral and history is provided comprising a server and an application executing on the server. The system receives a message from a motorist device requesting roadside automotive service and determines a geographic location of motorist device. The system also sends descriptions of providers of requested roadside service to the motorist device, the providers proximate the geographic location. The system also sends cost of requested roadside service quoted by each provider. The system also dispatches to the geographic location, based on a selection received from the motorist device, a first provider of the providers. The providers are previously qualified by the system to provide the requested roadside service proximate the geographic location.

Titulo: Touchless maintenance (automated vehicle service provider platform)
Resumo: Systems and methods for an automated process for vehicle service. In particular, an individually owned vehicle is integrated with a service provider platform for a fleet of vehicles such that data flows bidirectionally between the vehicle and the platform. The bidirectional flow of data enables an intelligent and automated end-to-end maintenance and/or repair process for the individually owned vehicle, including issue detection, accident management, and seamless vehicle exchange. For example, the vehicle can send a signal to the platform to schedule a repair and request a replacement vehicle from the platform during the repair. The platform can coordinate with a facility to schedule the repair, send a signal to the vehicle to autonomously drive itself to the scheduled repair, and provide a replacement vehicle to the vehicle's home during the repair.

Titulo: Customer-customized service provision system through linkage between vehicle maintenance companies
Depositante_Principal: JUNG GWANG MYEON [KR] | LEE CHANG EON [KR]
Resumo: Provided is a system for providing a customized maintenance service, the system comprising: a user terminal configured to transmit maintenance request data to request maintenance of a vehicle to be maintained; a rental car management server configured to manage the allocation of a rental car; a pickup service providing server configured to manage a person in charge of providing a pickup service; and a maintenance service providing server configured to receive the maintenance request data and manage a maintenance schedule for the vehicle to be maintained, receive an allocated rental car through the rental car management server, and receive an allocated person in charge of providing the pickup service for the carriage of the allocated rental car and the vehicle to be maintained from the pickup service providing server. According to the present invention, the system can have the effect of quickly managing schedules and improving user convenience through expected repair details in regard to the provision of a maintenance service for a vehicle to be maintained, and can have the effect of providing an efficient maintenance service by minimizing responses to repetitive inquiries even in a maintenance site where maintenance is performed.
Depositantes_Orig: JUNG GWANG MYEON [KR] | LEE CHANG EON [KR]

Titulo: Path planning system and method in field service business
Depositante_Principal: SHANGHAI TAIJU DATA TECH CO LTD
Resumo: The invention provides a path planning system and a method in field service business, which comprises the following steps: the first acquisition module is used for processing the acquired historical service data of each service network point to obtain the historical service frequency ratio of all the service network points; the second acquisition module is used for respectively acquiring a first distance between the service network node and the service center and a second distance between the service network node and all other service network nodes except the service network node to form a distance matrix; the path planning module is used for processing according to the historical service frequency ratio and the distance matrix to obtain a plurality of service paths and corresponding scheduling frequencies; and the scheduling module is used for processing according to the plurality of service paths, the scheduling frequency, and a preset upper limit value and a preset lower limit value of the interval time between two adjacent services of each service network point to obtain the service sequence combination of each service path and the scheduling interval time between two adjacent service paths. The method has the advantages of being suitable for operation scenes with indefinite or indefinite duration and reducing long-term operation cost.
Depositantes_Orig: SHANGHAI TAIJU DATA TECH CO LTD

Titulo: Vehicle failure repair method and vehicle failure repair system
Depositante_Principal: DAIHATSU MOTOR CO LTD; ダイハツ工業株式会社
Resumo:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a vehicle failure repair system capable of quickly selecting an available repair shop from among a wide range of repair shops, as well as repair shops affiliated with a vehicle manufacturer.

SOLUTION: A vehicle failure repair system 1 includes a vehicle failure information acquisition unit 11, a vehicle location information acquisition unit 12, and a vehicle-side communication unit 13 which transmits vehicle failure information and vehicle location information to a first service providing unit 30. The first service providing unit 30 receives the vehicle failure information and the vehicle location information, and transmits the information to a second service providing unit 40 that manages repair shops 50 integrally. The second service providing unit 40 searches for a repair shop 50 which can repair a vehicle 10 on the basis of the vehicle failure information and the vehicle location information, selects an available repair shop 50A, and transmits the vehicle failure information and the vehicle location information to a shop-side terminal device 51 of the available repair shop 50A. The shop-side terminal device 51 transmits repair instruction information and tow-truck dispatch instruction information on the basis of the vehicle failure information and the vehicle location information.

Titulo: Vehicle maintenance management method and system
Resumo: The invention provides a vehicle maintenance management method and a system, wherein the vehicle maintenance management method comprises the following steps: acquiring position information and fault types of a vehicle to be maintained; determining the vehicle estimated cost of the vehicle to be maintained according to the fault type of the vehicle to be maintained; generating a vehicle maintenance order based on the position information, the fault type and the estimated vehicle cost of the vehicle to be maintained; and pushing the optimal vehicle repair service information for the vehicle to be repaired according to the vehicle repair order. Through the technical scheme of the invention, the optimal automobile repair service information can be intelligently pushed for the user to select when the vehicle breaks down, so that the time of the user is saved, the whole maintenance period is greatly shortened, and the use experience of the user is improved.

Titulo: Dynamic matching system for driver dispatching with application to on-demand service platforms
Depositante_Principal: BIAN YUAN DR [CN] | WANG TIANYU DR [CN] | WU DESHENG PROF [CN]
Resumo:
With the development of technological advances in mobile networks and Global Position System, 
on-demand services have emerged on a massive scale. We propose a measurement-based 
algorithm, which is capable to deal with online case in large scale and to approximate the optimum 
at a ratio o for cost minimization. The request-driver measurement is based on four factors: 
passenger's waiting time calculated by the drop-off time of its last request plus the drive from the 
drop-off location to the pick-up location of the request; the time to home after serving the request; 
the requests density to evaluate the benefit to serve the current order; the importance of the order, 
which may reflect the revenue or the willing to pay. The request is assigned to the driver with the 
lowest measurement. The system will also set a threshold and reject the requests whose 
measurement function is above the threshold for all drivers.

Titulo: Automatic dispatch system for tow service providers
Resumo: A work assignment request message, generated by a user device based on input provided by a tow service provider via the user device, is received at an enterprise server device. An initial pool of tow request stocks for potential fulfillment by the tow service provider is selected from a set of pending tow request stocks. A refined pool of tow request stocks is generated to exclude, from the initial pool, tow request stocks for which the tow service provider does not meet at least one fulfillment requirement. An optimized pool of tow request stocks is generated to include one or more tow request stocks selected, according to one or more optimization criteria, from the refined pool of tow request stocks. Information assigning the tow request stocks in the optimized pool of tow request stocks is transmitted from the enterprise server device to the user device.

Titulo: Route-based digital service management
Depositante_Principal: SYDIR JAROSLAW J [US] | LI BIN [US] | METSCH THIJS [DE]
Resumo: Various systems and methods for route-based digital service management are described herein, comprising receiving a request for service, such as a user request for service from a MaaS or digital service provider, estimating digital service usage with respect to the request, determining a MaaS route using the request and the estimated digital service usage, selecting an orchestration strategy comprising a server type using the estimated digital service usage, and scheduling a MaaS vehicle for the determined MaaS route in response to the request using the selected orchestration strategy and the determined candidate MaaS route.
Depositantes_Orig: SYDIR JAROSLAW J [US] | LI BIN [US] | METSCH THIJS [DE]

Titulo: Near-real-time collaborative vehicle repair estimating tool
Resumo: A near-real-time collaborative vehicle repair estimating tool is provided. In general, one aspect disclosed features a system, comprising: a hardware processor; and a non-transitory machine-readable storage medium encoded with instructions executable by the hardware processor to perform a method comprising: providing at least one view of a repair estimate record to a plurality of client devices; receiving a revision of the repair estimate record from one of the client devices; generating a revised repair estimate record by revising the repair estimate record according to the received revision responsive to receiving the revision of the repair estimate record; and providing at least one view of the revised repair estimate record to the plurality of client devices in near real time with receiving the revision of the repair estimate record.

Titulo: Method for providing maintenance service and application and server implementing the same
Resumo: A method for allowing a server to provide a vehicle maintenance service comprises the following steps of: storing maintenance item information including part information matching a vehicle identification number of each vehicle and a maintenance cycle for each part information and information on maintenance companies; receiving vehicle information including a vehicle identification number from a terminal; extracting maintenance item information matching the vehicle based on the received vehicle identification number and predicting a maintenance time for each maintenance item by inputting the vehicle information and the maintenance item information into a learned maintenance time prediction model; and transmitting estimated costs or part costs of the maintenance companies matching a corresponding maintenance item to a terminal according to the predicted maintenance time.

Titulo: System for providing non face-to-face based automotive repair service
Resumo: A non-face-to-face vehicle repair agency service provision system is provided. The system includes: at least one AS center terminal that uploads quotations corresponding to a vehicle repair application when applying for merchant registration and receiving the vehicle repair application, uploads vehicle a repair result as a report if the quotation is selected, and receives settlement for vehicle repair in real time or periodically; a user terminal that uploads a vehicle repair request, receives quotations from at least one AS center terminal, selects one of the received quotations and output the request event, receives a report, which is the result of vehicle repair, and pays the payment; and a repair agency service providing server. The repair agency service providing server includes: a registration unit registering at least one AS center terminal as an affiliate; a request unit for requesting quotations to at least one AS center terminal when a vehicle repair application is uploaded from the user terminal; a transmission unit for performing transmission to a user terminal when the quotations are received from at least one AS center terminal; a request unit that transmits a request event to the AS center terminal that has uploaded the selected quotation when the user terminal selects one quotation; a requesting unit requesting payment to the user terminal when a report is uploaded from the AS center terminal; and a settlement unit that performs settlement to the AS center terminal when payment is completed in the user terminal.

Titulo: Vehicle assistance apparatus and method
Resumo: A roadside assistance system includes at least one processor and at least one data storage device communicatively coupled to the at least one processor. The at least one processor is operable to provide a first navigator style interface to a service user; prompt, via the first navigator style interface, the service user to provide a user vehicle identifier to identify a vehicle of the service user; receive the user vehicle identifier; present a plurality of roadside service options to the service user; receive a user service selection of the plurality of roadside service options from the service user; receive a user location of the service user; match the user service selection to a service provider; and provide the service provider with the user service selection, the user vehicle identifier, and the user location.

Titulo: Roadside Assistance System and Method
Resumo: A roadside assistance system and method. The system includes a user device and a plurality of provider devices, each including a display, an input mechanism, a GPS module, a wireless transceiver, a processor, a non-transitory computer readable medium operatively connected to the processor, and a logic stored in the non-transitory computer readable medium that, when executed by the processor, causes the system to perform a method. The method includes receiving information relating to current traffic conditions from a remote database, calculating an optimal service provider based on service provider locations, work status, and current traffic conditions, and displaying an estimated arrival time based on current traffic conditions. The system allows users to quickly and easily request roadside assistance with the assurance of an accurate arrival time.

Titulo: Synchronized interactive voice response system and GUI for automated roadside service
Resumo: Systems and methods are disclosed for providing roadside service through a synchronized interactive voice response (IVR) system and graphical user interface (GUI). One method may include: receiving, based on an incoming phone call from a vehicle user device, a request for roadside service for a disabled vehicle of a vehicle user; sending a text to a phone number of the vehicle user device, wherein the text includes a link to a mobile application for roadside service requests; receiving, from the vehicle user device and via the mobile application, information associated with the request for roadside service; determining, based on a location sensor of the vehicle user device, a location of the disabled vehicle; matching a roadside service provider with the disabled vehicle based on the request for roadside service; and enabling the vehicle user to track the service status of the roadside service provider through the mobile application.

Titulo: Apparatus and Method For Dispatching a Tow Truck In Response To a Roadway Emergency
Resumo: A method of operating an emergency services system entity is disclosed. The method includes receiving, by the emergency services system entity, data from a plurality of data sources; determining that a vehicle collision occurred based on the received data; determining a vehicle collision location; and sending a tow truck dispatch request to a plurality of tow truck dispatch systems in response to determining that a vehicle collision occurred, where the request includes the vehicle collision location.

Titulo: Car Repair Cost Estimation Service
Resumo: The present invention relates to a vehicle repair cost estimation service, which includes the steps of: transmitting a vehicle image or video data transmitted from a customer terminal to a repair shop terminal; and displaying quotation data transmitted from the repair shop terminal so that the quotation data can be checked on the customer terminal. The present invention can propose an appropriate service to meet the needs of a vehicle owner, and improve the satisfaction of the vehicle owner.

Titulo: Cloud service platform, GNSS/GPS Map, and App to find licensed mechanic engineer in close area
Resumo:
The present invention provides a method and system combining cloud service platform, GNSS/GPS Map, and App over mobile phone or computer to solve the issues while Automobile/boat/motorbike/bike users need to find mechanic engineer (licensed) to service their automotive/boat/motorbike/bike in close area. The service providers can easily find where the customers are located and they can communicate via the App, computer and cloud system to exchange information data, and get all their services done.
It benefits both the service users and service providers via the App and cloud system. The services include battery repair/change, refill the fuel, tire repair/change, all mechanic issues, software and hardware inspection and repair. The system also helps the service users to find a place to park their car on road and parking charge fee over the App with GNSS/GPS map and postcode software installed in the App or computer online.
The invention also have the function to link household owners and licensed plumbers, electricians, alarm technicians, computer engineers to get all users home appliances fixed and household repaired.
The method integrates satellite (GPS, BDS, GLONASS or GALILEO, later referred to GNSS) maps, PC/Mobile terminals, mobile phone with the App downloaded, and cloud servers. Titulo: Roadside assistance system (API for roadside service dispatch)
Resumo: According to some aspects of this disclosure a roadside assistance application programming interface (API) may allow any type of application, internet of things device, voice recognition device, and others to provide roadside assistance functionality. According to some aspects of this disclosure a device may communicate with sensors or an on-board diagnostics system of a vehicle and retrieve vehicle data. The device may recommend a service based on the vehicle data. The device may send a request for roadside assistance. The device may be used to enroll a user as a member of a roadside assistance benefits program. The above mentioned steps may all be performed via a single application running on the device. According to some aspects of this disclosure a device may process a roadside assistance request and determine a roadside assistance service provider to send to a user that requested roadside assistance.

Titulo: Roadside assistance program
Resumo: Systems, apparatuses, and methods for providing roadside assistance services are described herein. The system may include network computing devices and computing devices associated with user vehicles and service vehicles. The system may predict incoming requests for roadside services, and may allocate service providers among various geographical regions and/or time slots to handle the incoming requests. The system may receive a request for a roadside service from a user. The system may select an appropriate service provider to assist the user, and may assign the service request to the selected service provider.

Titulo: Dynamic processing system for roadside service control and output generation
Resumo: Aspects of the disclosure relate to a dynamic processing system for roadside service control and output generation. A computing platform may receive, from a client device, video content corresponding to a disabled vehicle, which may include geotagging information corresponding to a location of the disabled vehicle. Based on the video content and the geotagging information, the computing platform may determine a provider output indicating a potential service provider for assisting with the disabled vehicle. The computing platform may send, to the client device, an indication of the provider output. In response to receiving an indication that the potential service provider is acceptable, the computing platform may send a request to dispatch a driver of the potential service provider to the location of the disabled vehicle.

Titulo: System and Methods for Analyzing Roadside Assistance Service of Vehicles in Real Time
Resumo: Systems, apparatuses, and methods for providing roadside assistance services are described herein. The system may include network computing devices and computing devices associated with user vehicles and service vehicles. The system may predict incoming requests for roadside assistance services, and may allocate service providers among various geographical regions and/or time slots to handle the incoming requests. The system may receive a request for a roadside assistance service from a user. The system may select an appropriate service provider to assist the user, and may assign the service request to the selected service provider.

Titulo: Systems and methods for allocating a service request
Depositante_Principal: BEIJING DIDI INFINITY TECHNOLOGY & DEV CO LTD [CN]
Resumo: A method for allocating a service request is provided. The method may include: receiving a service request from a terminal of a service requester, the service request being for a transport service and including a pick-up location and a drop-off location; determining a first service provider to provide the transport service; generating a first service order allocating the service request to the first service provider; receiving a request for navigation associated with the first service order at a second moment; generating route information based on a second location of the first service provider at the second moment and the pick-up location; determining whether to reallocate the service request to a second service provider based on the route information; further generating a second service order reallocating the service request to the second service provider; and transmitting signals to a terminal of the second service provider.

Titulo: Method for mediation car repair service
Resumo: The present invention relates to a method for mediation a car repair service. The method includes: a step in which a repair operator terminal (120) applies for registration as a professional repair operator (S210); a step in which a mediation server (110) matches and stores the repair service provider information to the specialized repair field (S212); a step in which a user terminal (130) requests a car repair service (S214); a step in which the mediation server (110) determines "specialized field of repair" of the car repair service requested by the user terminal (130) (S216); a step in which the mediation server (110) selects a stored repair service provider matched to the determined specialized field of repair (S218); a step in which the repair target information is transmitted to the repair operator terminal (120) of the selected repair operator (S220); a step in which the repair operator terminal (120) receiving the repair target information transmits the repair estimate information to the mediation server (110) (S222); a step in which the user terminal (130) receiving the repair estimate information transmits response information of acceptance or rejection of the estimate information to the mediation server (110) (S226); and a step of transmitting user information and mediation approval information to the repair operator terminal (120), and transmitting information of the repair operator approved for quotation and mediation approval information to the user terminal (130) (S230). Accordingly, a repair service can be performed at low costs. COPYRIGHT KIPO 2023

Titulo: A computer-implemented method for vehicle emergency assistance
Resumo: In a vehicle emergency whether a breakdown or an accident, assistance usually provided by random towing service provider. The vehicle is then towed to workshop that affiliates with the towing service provider. At most time, the vehicle owner unable to make a choice during this process. If the driver wish to get the repair done at panel workshop, additional cost is charged to the vehicle owner. The present invention is directed to a computer- implemented method for vehicle emergency assistance (10) comprising sending user assistance request by user device (11); receiving the user assistance request and user location data by server (12) over communication network; retrieving user data from server database to server processor; analyzing user assistance requirement by the server processor; generating assistance requirement data and stored the assistance requirement data in the server database by the server processor; transmitting the user location data to nearest towing service provider (13) by the server (12); forwarding the user data to insurer (14) by the server (12); sending relevant police station (15) information to user device (11) by the server (12) to enable user to make police report; displaying list of a number of panel workshop (16), which are relatively closest in distance to user location, on the user device (11), as a choice; and notifying the towing service provider (17) by server (12) the panel workshop (16) selected by the user.

Titulo: Breakdown maintenance system (remote assistance and price verification)
Depositante_Principal: SUZHOU JUNCHE INFORMATION TECH CO LTD
Resumo: The invention discloses a kind of emergency maintenance system, it includes accident record module, remote assistance module, preengages module of verifying prices, repairs interactive module and payment module of validating the car；The accident record module, it is used for on-the-spot record accident situation and is saved in server, and the data damaged on car that will be recorded is sent to Automobile Service service provider and enters driving damage assessment；The remote assistance module, it is used to for the car damage data very first time to be sent to neighbouring some Automobile Service service providers, and the car that each Automobile Service service provider provides specialty in the very first time damages assessment for car owner's reference.The emergency maintenance system that the present invention is provided, it is convenient and swift, accident evaluation (record, appraisal) can be rapidly performed by, conveniently carry out auto repair；The present invention constitutes the physical basis of warning system using mobile terminal, communication network and alarm center server, can in time, it is reliable, implement to save exactly.

Titulo: Vehicle repair and maintenance intermediation service system and method thereof
Resumo: The present invention relates to a vehicle repair management relay service system and a method thereof. The present invention comprises: at least one vehicle repair management request terminal for performing an application service for receiving vehicle repair management; at least one vehicle repair management company terminal for performing an application service for a vehicle repair management company; and a vehicle repair management relay server for receiving repair management quotation request information data of a corresponding vehicle transmitted when a repair management quotation of a vehicle which is desired to be repaired and managed is requested by using the application service for receiving vehicle repair management, transmitting the data to an application for a vehicle repair management company of each vehicle repair management company terminal so that a trade can be made with a vehicle repair management company registered as a member on the basis thereof, receiving the repair management quotation response information data of the corresponding vehicle for the repair management quotation information data of the corresponding vehicle transmitted by using the application service for the vehicle repair management company of each vehicle repair management company terminal, and providing a relay service to transmit the same to the application for receiving vehicle repair management of the corresponding vehicle repair management request terminal. According to the present invention, the present invention has an effect of rapidly providing repair management information and a quotation service of a vehicle at low costs anytime and anywhere by comparing repair management quotation prices for each vehicle repair management company from the viewpoint of a vehicle repair management requester.

Titulo: Allocation of dynamically batched service providers and service requesters
Resumo: A processor device has a CPU cooperating with an input device and an output device, under control of stored instructions, and is arranged to receive service requests at the input device, assign service requests received in successive time periods to respective batches of requests; access stored service provider data to identify available service providers from among a pool of service providers; after completing the assignment of service requests to a batch, perform a matching process to endeavour to match each service request of the batch of requests to a service provider; and for each service provider to whom a match is made, output a notification of the respective potential match from the output device.

Titulo: Systems and methods for allocating orders in an online on-demand service
Depositante_Principal: BEIJING DIDI INFINITY TECHNOLOGY & DEV CO LTD [CN]
Resumo: Systems and methods for allocating orders in an online on-demand service are provided. A method may include: obtaining a plurality of driver-order pairs, each driver-order pair including an order to be allocated and a driver to be allocated; for each driver-order pair, determining a first matching value based at least partly on the driver and the order in each driver-order pair, obtaining an allocation factor, wherein the allocation factor is associated with a service score of the driver in each driver-order pair, and determining an adjusted matching value based on the first matching value and the allocation factor; identifying a plurality of matched driver-order pairs from the plurality of driver-order pairs, each matched driver-order pair including an order to be allocated and a corresponding matching driver, wherein the plurality of matched driver-order pairs are independent of each other and a sum of a plurality of adjusted matching values corresponding to the plurality of matched driver-order pairs is maximized; and allocating each order to the corresponding matching driver.
Depositantes_Orig: BEIJING DIDI INFINITY TECHNOLOGY & DEV CO LTD [CN]

Titulo: On-road vehicle service handling method
Resumo: A computerized, on-road, vehicle service handling system involves, a motor vehicle having therewithin a global positioning system (GPS) navigation system, an on-board diagnostic (OBD) system, a display within the vehicle, non-transitory storage having stored therein payment information, and at least one processor. While a user is driving a vehicle between first and second locations, upon receiving a fault condition signal from the OBD system, the processor will; automatically identify, and transmit information, to multiple vehicle service locations within a limited distance radius of the path towards the second location, receive service responses, receive a selection by the user of at least two of the vehicle service locations and an order of preference thereof; send a service request with payment information to the first selected vehicle service location; and receive a communication from the first vehicle service location either accepting or rejecting the request.

Titulo: Method for providing comparative estimation service of vehicle servicing
Resumo: Disclosed are a method for providing a comparative estimation service of vehicle maintenance and a server operating the same. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the server providing a comparative estimation service of vehicle maintenance comprises: a communication part; a storing part storing at least one vehicle number and vehicle related information corresponding to the vehicle number; an information receiving part receiving the vehicle number of a user vehicle and a vehicle maintenance estimation request of the vehicle from the user device; an information confirming part confirming the vehicle related information related to the vehicle number of the user on the storing part; and an estimation managing part transmitting the confirmed vehicle related information and the vehicle maintenance estimation request to at least one maintenance company device receiving maintenance information according to the maintenance of the vehicle from the at least one maintenance company device, respectively, generating comparative estimation information based on the received estimation information, and transmitting the information to the user device.

Titulo: Vehicle maintenance manager
Resumo: A method and system are provided for managing maintenance services performed on a vehicle. A service provider system receives a request from an on-board vehicle diagnostic system for charging or replacement of a battery of a rechargeable electric vehicle. Based on a set of rules from one or more databases, the service provider selects a charging facility to perform the battery charging or replacement. The service provider system, based on dynamic pricing parameters, determines a value for the battery charging or replacement and provides to the vehicle the selected charging facility location and value for the battery charging or replacement.

Titulo: Systems and methods for automobile maintenance scheduling
Resumo: An automobile maintenance application may link automobile owners with service providers and provide service reminders based on manufacturers' recommended scheduled maintenance. The automobile maintenance application may maintain maintenance records for automobiles. The automobile maintenance application may provide a system for service providers to send targeted advertisements to automobile owners in need of a service. The maintenance application may allow automobile owners to compare the prices and services of local service providers and benefit from the value associated with competition between service providers that is realized during a live or proxy auction.

Titulo: Real-time update of a mobile workforce schedule
Resumo: A method, apparatus and product for real-time update of a Mobile Workforce Scheduling Problem (MWSP), which comprises: agents and tasks to be performed by the agents, wherein a schedule which solves the mobile workforce scheduling problem exists and is being implemented by the agents. The method comprising: monitoring real time information update events provided to a Business Rule Management System (BRMS), activating, by the BRMS, business rules for schedule change detection; in response to a determination that re-planning is desired, automatically determining, using business rules, a portion of the MWSP to be re-planned; providing the portion of the MWSP to a MWSP solver; receiving from the MWSP solver, a new schedule for the portion of the MWSP; and updating the schedule based on the new schedule, whereby a first portion of the schedule is updated and a second portion of the schedule remains unchanged.

Titulo: System and method for locating nearby vehicle service providers
Resumo: A system and method for locating nearby vehicle service providers is disclosed. The method includes obtaining location information from a vehicle operator's mobile device that is used in vehicle breakdown situation to make a service request. The location information is used to determine a list of nearby service providers that are capable of assisting. Preferably, pricing information is provided so that the vehicle operator can select and pay the service provider from the mobile device in order to quickly return the vehicle to operational service.

Titulo: Real time Tow Truck business model (mobile application for booking tow truck by proximity and price)
Resumo: Abstract (57) An application for booking a tow truck via a mobile device. User is able to choose a tow truck service based on availability, proximity, price and speed of service. Tow truck businesses that are part of the system get increased exposure to customers and jobs when they are available.

Titulo: Automatic calculation of car repair quote system and method
Resumo: The present invention relates to an automatic calculation system for a vehicle repair estimate and a method for the same. The automatic calculation system for a vehicle repair estimate enables an owner to accurately estimate a vehicle repair estimate sum by recognizing an accident part of a vehicle by using an image photographed by a photographing unit (for example, a camera and a smartphone) and automatically calculating and providing a repair estimate based on the recognized image. The automatic calculation system for a vehicle repair estimate includes: an image obtaining unit obtaining and providing the image on an accident vehicle; a vehicle repair estimate calculating device recognizing a repair part by extracting the repair part from the image provided by the image obtaining unit, setting the repair part by linking components of the recognized repair part to a corresponding vehicle component which is registered in advance, and calculating and providing a vehicle repair part recognizing result and the vehicle repair estimate; and a user terminal requesting the calculation of the repair estimate on the accident vehicle by being connected to the vehicle repair estimate calculating device via a network and displaying the image on the vehicle repair part and vehicle repair estimate provided from the vehicle repair estimate calculating device on a screen.

Titulo: Intelligent towing service intermediation system and method for processing same
Resumo: Disclosed is an intelligent towing service intermediation method comprising the steps of: (a) receiving a service request including location information and towing destination information from a terminal of a towing service user; (b) subdividing a route section between a departure and a destination into a plurality of element sections according to whether a service is provided for free and/or the availability of a service, and mapping different towing service providers to each element section so as to generate a cost-effective route plan for supporting a towing relay service; (c) transmitting towing command information to towing service providers assigned according to the cost-effective route plan; and (d) transmitting information on the cost-effective route plan to the terminal of the towing service user.

Titulo: System and method for obtaining vehicle servicing, repairs and parts pricing
Resumo: In order to obtain multiple pricing for vehicle parts, servicing or repair, a smart phone application is used to transfer specific vehicle data to a website, which allows a plurality of vehicle repair service providers (VRSPs) to review the information, and provide pricing. In at least some embodiments, one or more of the following types of processes are involved. The user retrieves VIN data through scanning, wireless or manually entering. The Vehicle Identification Number (VIN) is transferred to the VRSP. The VRSP can review previous VIN information for that vehicle. The requested selects their preference for date and time of service/repair, and the VRSP must accept this date if making an offer. The VRSP provides a one-time cost response. The requester handles responses via a smart phone application. The smart phone application database maintains all VIN data for that vehicle, for future advertising purposes, and can transfer to new owners.

Titulo: Tow and emergency roadside assistance locating and tracking mobile application
Depositante_Principal: STATE FARM MUTUAL AUTOMOBILE INSURANCE CO [US]
Resumo: A system for providing dynamic roadside assistance coordination may include a customer mobile device or vehicle in direct, or indirect, wireless communication with an insurance provider and/or service provider remote server. The customer's device may transmit a request for roadside assistance (e.g., towing services), and a current GPS location. In response, a closest, trusted service provider vehicle may be determined, and then directed to the customer's location. For instance, a software application may receive the customer location and compare it with availability information to match the customer with a close and trusted service provider. The customer's device may receive an acknowledgement that help is on the way, and be able to track the current location of the service provider vehicle while en route. Payment for the roadside assistance may be automatically and electronically paid by the insurance provider. As a result, prompt and safe roadside assistance may be provided.
Depositantes_Orig: STATE FARM MUTUAL AUTOMOBILE INSURANCE CO [US]

Titulo: Role assignment for enhanced roadside assistance
Resumo: An enhanced roadside assistance system may modify service provider role assignments in roadside assistance accounts. The system may be configured to modify a service provider role assignment associated with a roadside assistance account by assigning a service provider role to each of a plurality of service providers. The system may receive a service request from a roadside assistance device for an individual associated with a vehicle. The system may identify one or more of the service providers offering a type of service indicated by the service request. Based on the service provider role assignment, the system may transmit a notification of the service request to at least one of a plurality of computing devices associated with one of the service providers. The system may receive a response comprising one or more discounts and transmit the response to the roadside assistance device for presentation to the individual.

Titulo: Vehicle maintenance appointment method and system
Resumo: The invention discloses a vehicle maintenance appointment method and system. The method comprises the following steps: a user logs in an intelligent mobile client side and builds communication connection with a server end; the user chooses an appointment time interval, a service type and service personnel and sends an appointment request to the server end; the server side receives the appointment request and judges whether the time interval exceeds the upper limit of service, if so, the server side feeds back to the mobile client side to remind the user to change the appointment request, and otherwise, an appointment is successful; after the success of the appointment, the server side notifies the appointed service personnel, and the service personnel notify a warehouse manager of preparing articles correspondingly according to the service type appointed by the user, and notify a maintenance factory of setting a maintenance sequence; after a vehicle enters an overhaul work station, the state information of the vehicle is submitted through the server side; the state information of the vehicle is displayed on the intelligent mobile client side in real time by a camera at the corresponding overhaul work station through a network. According to the method and the system, an appointment process is simplified, time is saved, the work load is reduced, and the working efficiency is improved.

Titulo: Roadside Assistance Management (allocating service vehicles to base stations)
Resumo: Methods, computer-readable media, software, and apparatuses provide a system for establishing base stations and allocating service vehicles to the base stations in order to provide roadside assistance. The system may include computing devices associated with customer vehicles and service vehicles as well as network computing devices. The system may receive a service request from a customer regarding a disabled vehicle. The system may then identify an appropriate service vehicle to assist the customer and assign the service request to the identified service vehicle. The system may select the appropriate service vehicle based on a location of the disabled vehicle. In an example, the system may choose a service vehicle from a base station closest to or within the shortest driving time to the disabled vehicle. By setting-up base stations in advance of service requests, service vehicles may reach disabled vehicles within a predetermined period of time.

Titulo: A method of generating of vehicle maintenance quote list and mobile device
Resumo: The present invention relates to a method for generating a vehicle repair estimate list in a mobile device and the mobile device generating the vehicle repair estimate list. The present invention can directly record a repair target vehicle in the field, select the component cost, labor cost, coating material cost, and coating paint cost of the repair target vehicle based on the recorded image or video, and generate the repair estimate for the repair target vehicle on a real-time basis. The method includes the steps of: executing an estimate application installed on a mobile device to be displayed on the main screen of the mobile device; displaying the image or video of the repair target vehicle recorded in the field after executing the estimate application; displaying upper selection groups corresponding to upper component parts generated by decomposing each parts of the repair target vehicle into multiple fragments and lower selection groups corresponding to lower component parts of the upper component parts on the screen; displaying detailed estimate option items to select the operation conditions corresponding to the one of the lower selection group selected by a selection input; generating a repair estimate list for the repair target vehicle according to the selection of the detailed estimate option items; and providing the repair estimate list to an estimate server and receiving the estimate cost for the repair target vehicle calculated based on the repair estimate list from the server.

Titulo: Roadside assistance service provider assignment system
Resumo: Aspects of the disclosure provide a computer-implemented method and system for the assignment of roadside assistance service providers such as tow trucks to distressed vehicles/drivers requiring roadside assistance. The methods and systems may include a roadside assistance service provider system with a collection module, an assignment module, and a feedback module. The collection module collects roadside assistance service provider information and historical statistics from real-world information and stores the information in a database that may then be analyzed using particular rules and formulas. The assignment module assigns particular roadside assistance service providers to particular distressed vehicles/drivers based on one or more characteristics. The feedback module may provide near real-time cues to the tow truck driver's mobile device, such as alerting when the amount of time spent on a task exceeds a predefined threshold, flagging high priority tasks/assignments, providing a step-by-step checklist for the repair.

Titulo: Crowdsourced Roadside Assistance Service Provider Assignment System
Resumo: Aspects of the disclosure provide a computer-implemented method and system for the assignment of crowdsourced roadside assistance service providers to distressed vehicles/drivers requiring roadside assistance. The methods and systems may include a roadside assistance service provider system with a collection module, an assignment module, and a feedback module. The collection module collects roadside assistance service provider information and historical statistics from real-world information and stores the information in a database that may then be analyzed using particular rules and formulas. The assignment module assigns particular roadside assistance service providers to particular distressed vehicles/drivers based on one or more characteristics. The feedback module may provide near real-time cues to the roadside assistance service provider's mobile device, such as alerting when the amount of time spent on a task exceeds a predefined threshold, flagging high priority tasks/assignments, providing a technical reference for the repair.

Titulo: Automobile repair plant matching optimization system and method for tire emergency repair

Resumo: The invention relates to the field of tire emergency repair, in particular to an automobile repair shop matching optimization system and method for tire emergency repair, comprising a database module, a database module and a database module, wherein the database module is used for receiving and integrating original tire damage data graphs from different scanning devices; the invention relates to a method for repairing a tire, which comprises the steps of judging a damage type by a damage cause identification module, calculating a damage index, judging repair feasibility by combining a built-in rule, calling a repair scheme matching module, screening and matching an adaptive feasible repair scheme, displaying the matching scheme to a repair technician by a repair resource scheduling module, guaranteeing the standardization of repair quality, supporting a user to check the repair progress in real time by the information intercommunication of a user end and a repair end, integrating multi-source data, accurately identifying the damage, intelligently matching the scheme, visually scheduling repair resources, realizing bidirectional transparency of the progress, and promoting the intelligent, standardized and efficient development of tire emergency repair service.
Depositantes_Orig: SHANGHAI HUILUN ENVIRONMENTAL PROT CO LTD

Titulo: Method And System For Optimizing Field Service Appointment Scheduling
Depositante_Principal: COCANOUGHER CHARLES D [US] | COCANOUGHER ROBERT A [US] | CHAMBERS STEPHEN F [US] | DODD BRADLEY A [US]
Resumo: A system and method for allowing a dispatcher and/or a service technician to achieve an optimized schedule for a few or a large number of service technicians performing repairs in the field based on an analysis of past data, methodologies and formulas, wherein a scheduling program is displayed to the dispatcher on a monitor of a computer or any other processing device, using the scheduling program the dispatcher calls up or accesses the current schedule of all the technicians, and the technicians can simultaneously view their entire current schedule and agree to a proposed appointment, even placing blocks on dates and times that they are not available for scheduling so that optimized or near optimized schedules are obtained quickly and economically.

Titulo: System and method for generating vehicle repair estimate reports based on predictive estimating
Resumo: Consumer safety of repaired vehicles can be improved by providing systems and methods for generating vehicle repair estimate reports based on predictive estimating and transmitting these reports to clients. A master server serviced by a vehicle manufacturer generates a vehicle repair estimate report based on predictive estimating and transmits this report to a client via a web-based graphical user interface. Also, a master server serviced by a vehicle manufacturer generates a vehicle repair estimate report based on predictive estimating and transmits this report to a client via a vehicle repair claims management user interface. The vehicle repair estimate report based on predictive estimating may comprise repair packages and repair information relating to recommended replacement parts and quantities thereof, the part numbers for the suggested replacement parts, the price estimate for the suggested replacement parts, manufacturer-recommended repair instructions, and other relevant information.

Titulo: Field service scheduling system and method based on artificial intelligence
Depositante_Principal: SHENZHEN QIANHAI ZHONGKE SHUKE INFORMATION TECH CO LTD
Resumo: The application relates to the technical field of project management, in particular to an artificial intelligence-based on-site service scheduling system and method. The method comprises the steps of preprocessing field service information to obtain a plurality of pieces of preprocessed information, creating a scheduling model, calculating the field task grade and the capability grade of a worker based on the field task information and the field personnel information through the scheduling model, carrying out service scheduling by combining the field task grade and the capability grade of the worker, finally collecting real-time field information and obtaining the real-time task grade, calculating the energy efficiency value of surrounding personnel based on the real-time field information, and carrying out field scheduling by combining the energy efficiency value and the real-time task grade.
Depositantes_Orig: SHENZHEN QIANHAI ZHONGKE SHUKE INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

Titulo: System and method for managing and providing vehicle maintenance
Resumo: A method for managing vehicle maintenance information set to utilize information obtained from a vehicle owner and a vehicle service provider to alert and educate the vehicle owner and the vehicle service provider about recommended maintenance scheduling, specific vehicle parts and repair requirements, vehicle diagnosis information, vehicle service history, real-time inventory management, vehicle maintenance costs, and scheduling of vehicle owners for vehicle maintenance at the maintenance facility. The system may coordinate the vehicle's maintenance information with the vehicle service provider and the vehicle owner through the use of various communication technologies and novel methods.

Titulo: Management of roadside service requests
Depositante_Principal: MARR CARY DUANE [US] | SUTFIN ROY B [US] | GOODYEAR TIRE & RUBBER [US]
Resumo: A method and apparatus to manage a service request involves the use of a smart phone's ability to communicate GPS information over the internet. A customer in need of roadside service can submit a roadside service request through a mobile web site or mobile application, and can provide location information through the smart phone's GPS receiver. Should the system not have a location for the customer, a unique URL can be created that identifies the service request and sent for the customer to access on the smart phone, which allows the web server to request the smart phone's GPS location and automatically associate it with the correct service request.
